input: s is an ASCII string of length in [0,4294967295]. Only A-Z and a-z are letters; digits, punctuation, spaces and control characters are nonletters. Integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool; list and string inputs are ordinary list/str values without subclasses. No concurrent mutation or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Size bounds do not guarantee available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: An immutable string with the list of letters reversed while every nonletter stays at its exact original index. Letter case and character multiplicities are preserved. Empty input is accepted.
mutation_aliasing: All input values, caller containers and ordering remain unchanged. The Solution instance retains no state and separate calls share no mutable result state. Swaps affect only a fresh character list. Equal returned strings need not have fresh object identity.
numeric: The helper performs exact ASCII range comparisons rather than language-dependent Unicode isalpha rules. Indices and -1 sentinels remain exact safe integers.
complexity: O(len(s)+1) time and auxiliary/result storage, including materializing characters and joining. Each pointer advances monotonically; each nonletter is skipped once and each letter is swapped at most once.
